text: Onon fewjooɓe, jarribee alyatiimaaɓe ɓen si ɓe hellifaama, jonnonɓe seeɗa e jawle maɓɓe ɗen ɓe haajitora, si ɓe haajitoriiɗe no haaniri, feeñanii on wonnde ɓe ƴoƴii ; haray jonnitee ɓe jawle maɓɓe ɗen no timmiri.Wata on ñaamir jawle maɓɓe ɗen fantingol ɓuri ko Alla Daginani on haajitorgol e majje, wata on yaccor ñaamugol ɗe fii wata ɓe hellife ɓe henndooɗe. Kala e mon tawɗo ko jogiiɗo jawdi, yo o haɗito ƴettugol jawdi alyatiima. Kala e mon kadi tawɗo ko waasiraaɗo jawdi, yo o haajitor yeru makko on. Si ɓe hellifaama on jonnitiiɓe jawle maɓɓe ɗen, seedinee e kon ko jonnitoton fii reenugol haqqeeji ɗin e fii wata on lurru. Alla Yonii Seediiɗo e ɗum, Hasboowo jeyaaɓe ɓen e golle maɓɓe.
